# WordConvertHTML

> Free online Word to HTML converter. Paste your Word document content, get clean, semantic HTML instantly. No installation, no sign-up. 100% private — runs in your browser.

## About

- [WordConvertHTML](https://wordconverthtml.com): Free, browser-based tool that converts Microsoft Word documents and rich text content into clean, semantic HTML. Runs entirely client-side, so no data ever leaves your device.

## Features

- [Word to HTML conversion](https://wordconverthtml.com): Paste Word content or upload .docx, get clean HTML with real-time preview
- [Automatic cleaning](https://wordconverthtml.com): Removes Word-specific markup and inline styles automatically
- [Semantic HTML output](https://wordconverthtml.com): Uses strong/em instead of b/i for clean, semantic markup
- [Export options](https://wordconverthtml.com): Export as HTML file, copy to clipboard, or print
- [9 cleaning tools](https://wordconverthtml.com): Remove styles, classes, IDs, comments, whitespace, and more
- [Dark mode](https://wordconverthtml.com): Fully responsive design with dark mode support

## How It Works

- [Paste or upload](https://wordconverthtml.com): Paste Word content into the editor or upload a .docx file
- [Auto-convert](https://wordconverthtml.com): The editor auto-converts and cleans the HTML
- [Refine](https://wordconverthtml.com): Use cleaning tools to further refine the output
- [Export](https://wordconverthtml.com): Export clean HTML via copy, download, or print

## Privacy

- [Privacy](https://wordconverthtml.com/privacy): All processing happens in the browser. No data leaves your device. No cookies, no analytics, no tracking.
